sn10.6:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā Anuruddho Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme || Tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Anuruddho rattiyā paccūsasamayaṃ paccuṭṭhāya dhammapadāni bhāsati || || Atha kho Piyaṅkara-mātā yakkhinī puttakam evaṃ tosesi || ||
sn10.6:2.1: Mā saddaṃ karī Piyaṅkara || bhikkhu dhammapadāni bhāsati || api ca dhammapadaṃ vijānīya || paṭipajjema hitāya no siyā || ||
sn10.6:3.1: pāṇesu ca saṃyamāmase || sampajānamusā na bhaṇāmase || sikkhema susīlyam attano || api muccema pisāca-yoniyā ti || ||
